name: USC Summer Programs: business courses (Introduction to Business, Exploring Entrepreneurship, and more)
what_you_do: Take one four-week college course. USC teachers and pros teach it. You can pick a business course. Choices include Intro to Business and Exploring Entrepreneurship. Others cover data and green business.
who_can_apply: High school students who have finished at least 9th grade by the start and take a rigorous course load. Domestic and international students may apply.
pay_detail: Summer 2026 prices: tuition $7,401, materials $300, program fee $325, health center $104. Total $8,130 commuter or $11,570 residential, plus an $85 application fee. No financial aid was mentioned. 2027 prices not posted.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application information is coming in November (the page does not give a 2026 deadline). The 2026 domestic deadline was May 8, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online with a 300 to 500 word essay, a teacher or counselor recommendation, a transcript and the application fee. You can rank up to three courses but you take one. Join the email update list for 2027 news.
notes: Expensive. Prices and deadlines above are the summer 2026 numbers; the 2027 numbers may change. The pages did not give an age limit.
